management-and-governance.text: On January 9, 2009, Issuer Direct Corporation (the “Company”) notified De Joya Griffith & Company, LLC. (“De Joya”) that effective January 9, 2009 the Company has decided to dismiss DeJoya as the Company’s independent registered public accounting firm. The decision to dismiss DeJoya was made and approved by the Company’s Board of Directors.
the Company engaged GBH CPAs, PC. (“GBH”) as its new independent registered public accounting firm. The decision to engage GBH was made and approved by the Company’s Board of Directors.
